title: rdp: parse RDSTLS packets
description:
Depending on the negotiated security type, we can have RDSTLS packets at the
beginning of the conversation. This patch adds support for these packets and
adjust the heuristic accordingly.

can you also look this 2 warnings (don't coming from this change but from new check)

```
packet-rdp.c hf_rdp_flagsPkt filter= rdp.flags.pkt - mask with non-contiguous bits SEC_PKT_MASK ( 0x4c1 )

packet-rdp.c:1337:35: warning: The left operand of '!=' is a garbage value [core.UndefinedBinaryOperatorResult]
```

The warning about `SEC_PKT_MASK` looks either like a false positive, or we must handle the dissecting differently.

I've did a try to remove the warning at `packet-rdp.c:1337:35` (I agree that the code is hard to read, although not mine)
